name: slurry_splash
source: A tanker's slurry distributor (splash plate or trailing hose). It touches nothing: no draft, no soil force, no depth (kind applicator). It works while switched on over workable ground, moving forward; the width comes from the model's two work sockets, the mass from the vehicle. Rates and tank contents belong to the game.

range.source: [AS] Usual working speeds of a slurry tanker 4-10 km/h (manufacturer ranges, not read from a standard); above 10 km/h the rate control lags, 0.10 per km/h to a floor of 0.4.
